name: Should I use a real estate agent for a pre-construction condo purchase?

mainEntity.name: Should I use a real estate agent for a pre-construction condo purchase?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is advisable to use a real estate agent specializing in new construction. An experienced agent, like those at Realty ONE Group Evolution, can provide valuable market insights into specific regions like Miami-Dade or Broward County, help negotiate terms, and guide you through the complex contract process. They represent your interests, often at no direct cost to you, as their commission is typically paid by the developer.
